metadata_description: Accessibility direction para navigation, forms, motion e responsive layouts.
title: UM product que remains usable em real conditions
description: Practicora aims para keyboard acesso, readable contrast, responsive layouts e motion que respects usuário preferences.
section_1_description: Interactive controls use visible foco states e predictable tab order.
section_2_description: Dense views reorganize para smaller screens instead de hiding essential ações.
section_3_description: Reduced-motion preferences limit decorative movement while preserving useful state changes.
section_4_description: Accessibility é treated as ongoing product work e should ser tested com real usuários e assistive technologies.
